message.content:
**Capture 1 (Beat 5 — Kiosk/QR Card)**
- **A) Text Readability:** **PASS.** All text (“Bina form. Bina pen.”, “WAITING · TOKEN #12”, “Check-in karo”, footer note) is fully legible at 390px width with no clipping or truncation.
- **B) Stacking/Collisions:** **PASS.** The QR card, status pill, CTA button, and helper text are vertically stacked with consistent padding; the horizon arc and “:0U diet report” FAB sit cleanly in the lower-right without overlapping the main card.
- **C) Horizontal Overflow:** **PASS.** No elements exceed the 390px viewport; the main card has proper border-radius and margin containment.
- **D) Polish:** **8/10.** Strong typographic hierarchy, clear visual weight on the QR zone, and professional monochrome palette. Minor deduction only for the slightly tight spacing between the button and the fine-print disclaimer.

**Capture 2 (Beat 6 — Doctor/Dark Dashboard)**
- **A) Text Readability:** **PASS.** The serif headline (“Doctor ko bhi dikhti hai aapki regularity — ilaaj behatar.”), subtext (“5 of 7 days”), and day labels (M T W T F S S) are all crisp and unclipped despite the dark theme.
- **B) Stacking/Collisions:** **PASS.** The circular progress indicator (15%), headline block, and weekly rail (7 day dots) are vertically sequenced with ample breathing room; the partial date cards at the bottom are properly contained within the scroll area.
- **C) Horizontal Overflow:** **PASS.** All content—including the wide serif line and the 7-column day rail—fits within the 390px width without horizontal scrolling or edge-cropping.
- **D) Polish:** **8/5 or 9/10.** Excellent use of contrast and negative space; the circular progress ring and dot-grid rhythm feel premium. The “REPRESENTATIVE” label and footer disclaimer add authentic system-ui texture. Very close to production-ready.

**Summary:** Both captures pass all functional checks. Capture 1 is a clean, instructional state; Capture 2 delivers strong atmospheric polish with its dark-mode dashboard aesthetic.
